page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 128 physical cores and 128 vCPUs, utilizing a dedicated CPU allocation model with one thread per core. Memory capacity totals 1024.0 GB, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external network-attached storage for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The lack of local NVMe drives and graphics accelerators represents a tradeoff, positioning the instance primarily for memory-bound and network-dependent workloads rather than local storage-intensive or parallel computing tasks.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 makes this instance suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data caching layers. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention, aligning the hardware profile with workloads such as large-scale SAP HANA deployments, real-time analytics, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.

It is qualitatively cost-efficient for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and real-time data analytics pipelines where high memory capacity and consistent processing performance are critical.
